published.source: Talent and rotation search, 2026-10-26: Holy Shock, Champion of the Light and Pursuit of Justice pinned; 20000 iterations, seed 1, 120 / 180 / 300 s

summary: Holy Shock with most points in Retribution: Seal of Command, Holy Shock and Consecrated Ground, Champion of the Light, no twisting and no Light's Vigil.
rotation: Consecration on cooldown, down to the last point of mana
Judgement on cooldown; re-seal Command whenever it is down (no twisting)
Hammer of Wrath below 20% health, ahead of Holy Strike
Holy Shock on cooldown; Divine Favor goes on a Holy Shock
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Dragonfire Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed) is taken by rule (standards 26).
Holy Shock needs 20 Holy points, so Twist of Light (the 31 point Retribution talent) is out of reach.
1.8% behind Level 60 (sub Holy) at 180s; 3.2% at 300s, where it runs short of mana (the Major Mana Potion is 10.3 better there, the Dragonfire Potion 5.7 better at 180s).
Holy Strike's flat bonus is inside the weapon percent (client data). Unconfirmed on the beta.
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% at stake).
No filler explosive (standards 11): each 1s cast resets the swing.
